Santos-Lingad DJ Timeline
May 2, 2014

Time Event Music/Notes
04:00 PM DJ arrival at the reception (The View Room)
Chardonnay Golf Club
2555 Jameson Canyon Rd. American Canyon CA, 94503

-DJ set-up ready
05:00 PM Guests at The View Patio (Cocktails-outdoor)
-after harp done playing , DJ will start playing romantic, classic, and mellow music
05:50 PM
-All guest must inside the view room (reception).
-DJ will welcome and announce all guests to be inside. DJ will play romantic, classic, and mellow music
06:00 PM – Bridal Party Introduction into the room
Bridesmaids & Groomsmen:
1. Jacqueline Pare & Ralph Nicer
2. Martha & John Villanueva
3. Rose Veluz & Mike Jimenez
4. Joy Lingad & Mark Jimenez

– Best Men & Maid of Honors:
– 1. George Lingad & Kritizia Santos
– 2. Rio Lingad & Sabrina Santos

– Newlyweds:
Mr. and Mrs. Jun and Christian Lingad

 Jun and Christian’s First Dance

 Father of Bride: Eddie Santos
 Mother of the Groom: Carmen Lingad

 Father of the Groom: Vic Lingad
Mother of the Bride: Angie Santos
– DJ will introduce the bridal party

– Introduction of Bridal Party Music: Any happy and up beat music.

Chardonnay Golf Club Wedding DJ will announce the newly wed.
-First Dance: Please play “Got to believe in magic “

– DJ will announce and call the Father of the Bride and Mother of the Groom (one minute dance only)

-After a minute, he will call the Mother of the Bride and Father of the Groom (One minute dance only)

06:30 PM

 Prayer
 Dinner
 AVP/Video

-DJ to call on Kritzia Santos to lead the prayer

-DJ to announce dinner
-DJ to announce the AVP

-Dinner music: -But please just classic, jazz, BUT upbeat music 🙂

07:15 PM  Cake cutting

 Toast – by Rio lingad (Brother of the groom)

 Message by parents. 1. Carmen Lingad – mother of the groom. then, 2.. Eddie Santos – father of the bride.

– DJ will announce Cake Cutting

– Cake Cutting music: “Just the Way You Are” by Bruno Mars

– DJ will announce the Toast and will call Rio Lingad for the toast

– DJ will call the mother of the groom Carmen Lingad
– Then,. then father of the bride “Eddie Santos

7:30 PM

08:00 PM 
DJ will announce last 30 minutes left for the open bar Beer and wine.. (up to 8pm only)

 Bouquet & Garter Toss

-Parttttteyyyy!!!!

-DJ will announce the Bouquet and Garter Toss

-Bouquet Toss Music: “Single Ladies” by Beyonce

-Garter Toss Music: “
 – Drink, dance, and be merry!!!

-Dance music: Provided by the couple

-But please just prepare dance/hip-hop/pop/ and contemporary music 🙂
10:30 PM  End. 🙂 THANK YOU! 🙂

_____________________________________________________________

Sylvia Bat Mitzvah – Temple Sinai
2808 Summit St, Oakland, CA 94609

Bat-Mitzvah Party, April 26th 2014

Games:

Group participation:

Things I want to do:
– candle lighting
– the chair hora
– last dance

Here are all the songs I would like you to choose from:
